intent: One cartridge is already Dad’s in my mind, but recognition cannot be the only test. Before I risk opening anything, I need a response that belongs to him rather than a habit the infection can imitate. I begin planning a controlled lure using the workshop light and familiar sounds while keeping a barrier between us. The other three cartridges already feel less like medicine than decisions I will eventually have to defend.
emotion: reflective, analytical, frightened, and cautiously hopeful
